test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the alternative which is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (Words should be treated as meaningful English words and words should not be related to each other based on the number of letters/ consonants/ vowels in the word)

Heart : Pumping :: Kidneys : ?
solution:
Heart : Pumping 

⇒ Heart is the primary organ of our circulatory system. It pumps blood throughout our body.

Similarly, Kidneys : ?

⇒ It is one of the excretory organ.It filters our blood by removing wastes and extra water to make urine.

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
